Authorities Order Mosque Demolition Over Alleged Encroachment

Authorities in Uttar Pradesh have issued a notice for the demolition of a mosque, citing its construction on government land. The notice directs the mosque management to dismantle the structure themselves. This action follows a similar directive in Himachal Pradesh's Sanjauli area, where a mosque also faced demolition orders due to alleged illegal construction. The Municipal Corporation court in Himachal Pradesh has issued orders for the bulldozer to proceed.
